general.title: General
general.uiLangDesc: Language of this window and the panel's labels.
general.targetDesc: Candidates are translated into this language.
general.countDesc: Only the first {{n}} candidates of each list are translated.
general.autostartDesc: Runs quietly after you sign in. No window or tray icon.
general.shortcutsDesc: Work in any app while you type.
general.imeDesc: Which input method Translate follows. Automatic follows whichever one you type with.

translation.title: Translation
translation.orderDesc: Cache first, then the local dictionary, then the translation service.
translation.localDictDesc: Instant, offline. Covers Chinese → English words (CC-CEDICT).
translation.serviceDesc: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Grok, OpenCode Go, DeepSeek, or any compatible service.
translation.apiKeyDesc: Stored in Windows Credential Manager. Never shown to other apps.
translation.jsonModeDesc: Faster, stricter parsing. Turn off if the service doesn't support response_format.

err.badUrl: The endpoint must start with https:// or http://.
err.auth: The service rejected this key (401). Check it was copied in full.
err.network: Can't reach the service. Check the endpoint and your connection.
err.timeout: The service didn't answer in time.
err.rate: The service is rate-limiting this key (429). Try again shortly.
err.http: The service returned an error. Check the endpoint and model.
err.parse: The reply wasn't a translation. Try another model, or turn off JSON output.
err.notFound: The endpoint wasn't found (404). Check the address — for OpenCode Go it is https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1.

translation.keySaved: A key is saved in Windows Credential Manager. Type a new one to replace it.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.desc: How the panel looks. Changes preview live.
appearance.previewDesc: Shown at actual size. Cancel reverts the panel.
appearance.offsetDesc: Distance from the input method's candidate window.
appearance.showOriginalDesc: Show the Chinese text next to each translation.
appearance.leadDesc: Shows the whole translation when candidate 1 doesn’t fit in its row.
appearance.clickableDesc: Moves the panel clear of the input method’s window, a little further from the candidates. Where the two overlap, WeChat Input Method takes all mouse input; shortcuts work either way.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.desc: What leaves this PC, and what is kept.
privacy.localOnlyDesc: Nothing is sent online. Only the local dictionary and cache are used.
privacy.denylistDesc: Candidates typed in these apps are ignored entirely.
privacy.passwordDesc: Translation stops in standard Windows password fields. Fields that apps draw themselves (some games, remote desktops, password managers) can't be detected — add those apps above.
privacy.storeTextVal: Common dictionary words only, encrypted on this PC. Everything else stays in memory.

about.title: About
about.quitDesc: Stops background translation until you open Translate again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.desc: Translate runs in the background while you type.
overview.reachDesc: There's no tray icon. Use these instead:
overview.serviceDesc: Single words already translate into English. A service adds phrases, sentences and the other languages.

showcase.title: Components
showcase.info: Saved. Translation now uses the new model.
